title: Final answers with a trailing note must still match the key (math/005 false FAIL) (REQ-0075)
acceptance_criteria: AC2 fix with tests, regression set re-scored

design.summary: scorer key match compares the value part: _numparse fails on sqrt keys so a note stays in the answer; add _note_match/_exact_value (additive, value must equal the key exactly, numbers in the note must agree); fix _TAIL_NOTE stripping sqrt(2)

implementation.summary: scorer value-part match with trailing note (additive), _TAIL_NOTE needs whitespace before the parenthesis

unit_test.result: 1304 tests, only baseline failures; replay of 36 saved items: exactly 2 diffs (math/005 FAIL->PASS in run1 and run2); adversarial false-pass pairs stay FAIL; sign kept in the note path; mutations killed; tester D1 sign flip fixed

verification.command: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/unit; free replay of 36 saved items; paid regression re-score run3
verification.result: REQ-0075 AC1, AC2 verified: 1304 tests, baseline failures only; replay shows only math/005 FAIL->PASS; adversarial false-pass pairs stay FAIL; sign kept; paid re-score 18 items 14 pass 0 fail 4 uncertain, 0.618 USD: math/005 FAIL->PASS as intended, math/gen-102 PASS->UNCERTAIN is a malformed model reply (scorer not involved); limits: pre-existing note-less sign blindness is REQ-0076, f(2) low item accepted, one malformed flake in 18
